title: MINTQA: A Multi-Hop Question Answering Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on New and Tail Knowledge
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (MINTQA) focused on multi-hop question answering for new and long-tail knowledge. While the dataset includes some factual triples related to religious figures or worldviews extracted from Wikidata (e.g., Islam, Saint George), the benchmark's purpose is to evaluate general multi-hop reasoning and retrieval capabilities, not religion, faith, ethics, or moral judgment systems specifically.
